changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW marketplace_estate_eligibility WITH (security_barrier = true) AS SELECT e.id AS estate_id, e.published AS published, (o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED') AS tenant_verified, o.marketplace_publishing AS tenant_entitled, (o.status = 'ACTIVE') AS tenant_active, -- CASE short-circuits, so the conflict function — the only -- expensive term — runs last, and only for estates that -- already pass every cheap condition. CASE WHEN e.published AND o.verification_state = 'VERIFIED' AND o.marketplace_publishing AND o.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (e.fees_declared_at IS NOT NULL OR e.fees_declaration_exempt) AND (e.fees_declaration_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false)) THEN (SELECT s.blocking_count FROM landvault_estate_conflict_summary(e.id) s) = 0 ELSE false END AS eligible, -- Declaring an EMPTY schedule counts: an estate with no -- extra charges may list, but by saying so. Silence does -- not, and the two are different facts. (e.fees_declared_at IS NOT NULL OR e.fees_declaration_exempt) AS fees_declared, -- RF-4: a developer who will not state what a buyer gets -- back does not get a listing. Its own boolean beside the -- others so the publish endpoint can name which one failed. (e.fees_declaration_exempt OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM estate_refund_terms rt WHERE rt.estate_id = e.id AND rt.deleted = false)) AS refund_terms_declared FROM estates e JOIN organizations o ON o.id = e.tenant_id AND o.deleted = false WHERE e.deleted = false;
